Proposals.Development: The party accepted the village elder's contract for fifty gold pieces, verified the payment, and began investigating the initial crime scene at Nella's farm where Elara identified goblin tracks and an iron arrowhead.
Proposals.Evidence: Elias picked up the pouch and set it aside carefully, checking its weight before opening it to count the coins inside. One by one, he laid them out on the table, arranging them in neat rows of five. There were ten rows of five, making fifty gold pieces total. He counted twice more just to be sure, confirming each row matched perfectly.
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: The party has transitioned from travelers to contracted investigators. They have secured the contract and gathered initial evidence (goblin tracks, arrowhead) at the first crime scene, establishing the nature of the threat as goblin raids.
Proposals.ProposedNextMilestone: Track the goblins through the woods to locate the ruined keep.
